title: Our story
intro: Iluro is the Roman name of Mataró, and from here the wines of ancient Layetania travelled in amphorae. Bodegas Iluro was born to revive that tradition: wines made with patience, close to the land where the vines grow.
milestones.title: A path through the vines
milestones.1.title: The first vines
milestones.1.text: Our grandfather plants the first vines on a small slope in the Maresme, for the family's own wine.
milestones.2.title: The first cellar
milestones.2.text: The stone cellar is built and the first oak barrels arrive. The wine starts to leave the family.
milestones.3.title: Second generation
milestones.3.text: The children take over, renew the vineyard and move to farming with less intervention and more respect for the soil.
milestones.4.title: A selection for your table
milestones.4.text: Each year we choose the best wines from our vines and from neighbouring cellars, and bring them to your home.
values.title: What drives us
values.1.title: Roots
values.1.text: We know the land, the history of Iluro and the people who work the vines.
values.2.title: Patience
values.2.text: Every wine takes the time it needs. We are in no hurry, and you can taste it.
values.3.title: Sharing
values.3.text: A good wine tastes better at everyone's table. That is why we offer it at an honest price.
cta.title: Shall we talk?
cta.text: Tell us what you are looking for and we will help you choose.
